# Journal Recorder

Shared safe summary core. Python stdlib. Private Markdown source, exact owned file commits, outgoing Git history scan.

Claude Stop/PostCompact and Codex exact-thread notify capture supported. Cursor afterAgentResponse and Gemini AfterAgent consume documented text fields. Copilot and other agents use manual stdin summary or shared skill. Native adapters tested with fake payloads, no live app smoke claimed.

Known secrets scrubbed before model, temp and save. Model failure skips entry. No raw fallback. Pattern scan cannot prove all prose safe. Private Git still sends data off machine.

Install from reviewed checkout with bash install.sh. Pick hooks using --agents. Optional Microsoft APM distributes root manual skill and core; it does not activate universal hooks.

Source and current steps: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/journal-recorder-agent
Renderer: https://github.com/GauravRatnawat/decision-ledger-setup
